title: Michaelis-Menten kinetics of wild-type vs E142A mutant
what: E142A mutant Km (~24 uM), wild-type Km (~6 uM), or the ~4x Km ratio

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: E142A increases Km ~3.7x (21.3 vs 5.8 uM) while Vmax stays nearly unchanged (45.2 vs 48.5 uM/min).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; triplicate scatter (~1.1 uM/min SD) is tight and cleanly separates the low-substrate binding region.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Because Vmax is preserved (~47–48 uM/min), the mutation impairs substrate affinity rather than maximal catalytic turnover.
